title: IBGR
subtitle: Influence-based group recommendation
description: Group formation and recommendation informed by trust, similarity, and leader influence. Accompanies my research on social dynamics in group recommender systems.

title: ITNRM
subtitle: Implicit trust-network modeling
description: Constructs implicit trust relationships from user ratings and evaluates the resulting trust network. The repository focuses on trust construction and evaluation metrics.

title: MulKD
subtitle: Multi-layer knowledge distillation
description: Implementation and experimental tools for the MulKD method by Guermazi et al. (2024), with model training, distillation, and evaluation on CIFAR-10.

title: A-LLMRec
subtitle: Language models meet collaborative filtering
description: Implementation and evaluation of the recommender system introduced by Kim et al. at KDD 2024, with training workflows and performance reporting.
attribution: Original method: Kim et al., KDD 2024.
